## About TrailOps

TrailOps is an AI systems, n8n automation, and SaaS development studio based in Sheridan, Wyoming, USA.
We operate as a premier AI automation services agency, designing and shipping working software — automation workflows, AI integrations, and full-stack SaaS products — for founders and teams who need results, not presentations.

Founded: 2024
Location: 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA
Contact: support@trailops.biz
Website: https://trailops.biz/

## Solutions & Services

TrailOps specialises in AI, automation, and managed services for growing businesses across seven core capability areas:

1. **Workflow Automation** — End-to-end n8n, Zapier, and Make pipelines that eliminate manual work: lead routing, CRM sync, multi-step approvals, notifications, and API orchestration.

2. **AI Integration** — LLM-powered features wired into existing products using GPT-4, Gemini, Claude, or self-hosted Ollama models. Use cases include content generation, classification, summarisation, RAG pipelines, and decision logic.

3. **AI Chatbots & Agents** — Custom conversational AI agents for support automation, lead qualification, onboarding, and internal Q&A. Embedded into web products or deployed as standalone tools.

4. **SaaS Development** — Multi-tenant SaaS applications built on Next.js, Supabase, and Stripe — from validated MVP to scalable product with auth, billing, and dashboards from day one.

5. **Social Media Automation** — AI-generated content pipelines for LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook: scheduled, personalised, and published automatically via platform Graph APIs.

6. **SEO Optimization** — Technical SEO, Schema microdata setup, search architecture design, and Core Web Vitals optimization to maximize organic search and AI search engine discoverability.

7. **Automation Strategy & Audit** — Operational mapping to identify the highest-leverage automation opportunities, delivering a ranked build plan with ROI analysis.

## Industries We Serve

TrailOps provides AI and automation solutions across multiple industries, partnering with:
- Early-stage founders who need a production-ready MVP
- Established product teams adding AI and automation layers
- Operators who need to eliminate manual processes at scale
- Companies that want full code ownership with no vendor lock-in

## Key Differentiators

- Full-stack delivery: design, build, deploy, and documentation handover in one engagement
- AI-native approach: AI is architected into systems from day one, not bolted on
- Fixed-price scoping: transparent, no gotcha scope changes
- Full ownership transfer: source code, docs, and deployment credentials handed over at completion
- No retainer required to keep systems running post-launch

## Toolchain & Technologies

Primary tools: n8n, Next.js, Supabase, Stripe, Vercel, PostgreSQL, Python, TypeScript
AI/LLM: OpenAI GPT-4, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Ollama (self-hosted)
Low-code: Airtable, Retool, Zapier, Make (formerly Integromat)
APIs: REST, GraphQL, Webhooks, LinkedIn Graph API, Meta Graph API

## Process

TrailOps uses a four-step engagement model:
1. **Discover** — Focused discovery call to understand goals, stack, and highest-leverage problems
2. **Scope** — Fixed-price quote with explicit deliverables and timeline
3. **Build** — Tight sprint cycles with regular async check-ins and early working demos
4. **Ship** — Deploy, verify, full access handover, warranty window

Typical project timelines:
- Single automation workflow: days to 1 week
- Full SaaS MVP: 3–6 weeks depending on scope

## Case Studies

- **LinkGrow** — AI-powered LinkedIn content creation SaaS with multi-tenant dashboard, LinkedIn Graph API scheduling, and engagement tracking
- **Flipbook SaaS** — PDF-to-flipbook platform with shareable embeddable viewer, lead capture, and analytics
- **Novodesk** — Retro-styled, web-based customer support platform designed to streamline inquiry management and ticket handling for teams. Features multi-workspace administration, role-based access control, analytics dashboards, and ticket queues (www.novodesk.cc)
